EC1: 1. American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical classification ≥ IV [OR] or the expected survival duration ≤ 24 h;
EC2: 2. Preoperative history of prostatic hypertrophy [OR] or glaucoma;
EC3: 3. History of myocardial infarction, severe heart dysfunction (New York Heart Association functional classification ≥ 3) [OR] or tachyarrhythmia within one year;
EC4: 4. Inhalation of β2-receptor activator, [OR] M-receptor blockers [OR] and/or glucocorticoids within one month before surgery;
EC5: 5. Severe renal dysfunction (requirement of renal replacement therapy) [OR] or severe hepatic dysfunction (Child-Pugh grade C);
EC6: 6. History of acute stroke within three months before surgery;
EC7: 7. Refuse to participate in the study [OR] or [NOT] unable to cooperate with the inhalation therapy;
EC8: 8. Participation in other clinical trial during the last month [OR] or within the six half-life periods of the study drug used in the last trial.
